skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts that already have a common denominator by subtracting numerators, keeping the denominator, and interpreting zero results when they occur.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator for unlike denominators and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Separate and combine mixed-number parts
skills.definition: Separate mixed numbers, whole numbers, or fractions into whole and fractional parts, treat missing parts as zero, subtract whole parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow across whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Simplify fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result to lowest terms.
